newsitem.title: USA: Dow surges to highs as long bond tests key level.
newsitem.headline: Dow surges to highs as long bond tests key level.

text.p: U.S. blue chips surged to session highs Thursday afternoon, propelled by a strong rally in the bond market.
The Dow industrials jumped 119 points to 7694. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by two-to-one on heavy NYSE volume of more than 420 million shares.
The Dow's most recent gains came as the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury rallied to test a key psychological level, gaining 1-2/32 to yield 6.76 percent.
"We've been dancing between 6.75 and 6.85 (percent) for the last several weeks, so a close below 6.75 would definitely be nice," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd.
Tech stocks continued to lag. The Nasdaq Composite gained four points to 1412. But among large cap stocks, the rally appeared to be gathering steam with each step higher.
"You now have all the fence sitters jumping in," Bleier said. "This is as momentum oriented as you can get."
